logp.method_description: The experiment was carried out using a modified shake flask method. Water saturated octanol was prepared by mixing 4 mL octanol and 1 mL water for 24 h, and octanol saturated water was also prepared in the same manner. After shaking, the layers were allowed to be settled, and they were separated. A 50 μM solution of the complexes was prepared in 1 mL saturated octanol, then 1 mL saturated water was added to it. The mixture was shaken for 24 h, centrifuged for 5 min at 4000 rpm, separated, and the complex concentration was determined by absorption spectroscopy. Finally, the lipophilicity coefficient was calculated using the formula given below: log Po/w = log ([complex]octanol /[complex]water)
